reviews.name: Molly Bohan
reviews.text: Uplift Local Media is an incredible resource for small businesses looking to grow their visibility and reach. Their indoor digital billboards are high-quality, eye-catching, and placed in all the right locations. In addition to that, they offer a full suite of marketing products that make it easy for any business to build a strong presence online and in the community. The team is knowledgeable, responsive, and genuinely committed to helping their clients succeed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Carter Cox
reviews.text: Kelsey & Amos at Uplift Local Media are incredibly sharp, responsive, and always go the extra mile for their clients. If you're looking for a group that knows digital advertising and how to tell your story the right way, these are your people. Highly recommend Uplift Local Media for those looking for affordable and effective advertising solutions!

reviews.name: Kelli Zimmer
reviews.text: Uplift local media is an amazing company that not only helps those wanting to market their business, but they also give back my letting local non-profits market their business on providing indoor digital billboards and marketing solutions for the local community. Check out Uplift Media today!

reviews.name: Linzie Stratmoen
reviews.text: As part of DakotAbilities, Uplift Local Media's work and creations have been incredible and come highly recommended.

reviews.name: Troy Styke
reviews.text: I worked with Amos and his team to help me build a website. They were great and listened to all my ideas and when the first draft came out it truly showed they listened and all my ideas were implemented. We had a few things we wanted to change and they got in those extremely quick and had my website up and running soon after that. There is no way I could have done this without them. I appreciate Amos and his team for all their help.

reviews.name: James Swanson
reviews.text: Uplift Local Media was great to work with. Their professionalism and expertise captured the message we wanted to share others.

reviews.name: Jadeyn Sjaarda
reviews.text: Kelsey and the Uplift Local Media team were amazing to work with! After filling out a form with our brand identity and advertising needs, they designed an attention-grabbing ad that met those goals and concisely communicated our message. Thanks for helping us share Habitat for Humanity's mission, Uplift Local Media!

reviews.name: Office Manager
reviews.text: Working with Uplift Local Media was wonderful! Kelsey designed a eye-catching ad that delivered our message well. She was gracious and reactive to our input in the process. I would highly recommend Uplift Local Media for your advertising needs.

reviews.name: Call To Freedom Sd
reviews.text: Thank you, Uplift Local Media, for your incredible support and outstanding work for our agency! We truly appreciate your dedication and are grateful to partner with such a fantastic team.
